profile.Name: Darren
profile.Personality: He says he tries to stay out of trouble, but trouble keeps finding him. He will not walk away from the raiders' cause and wants the United Cities to pay for what they have done. He calls the Empire's system corrupt and sees the Hook as rich ground for raiding.
profile.Backstory: Hook Raider. He lives in Kopek in the Hook, where he ended up while running from trouble. What the United Cities did to earn his hatred is not told. He would leave Kopek only with someone who also wants the Empire brought down, and only for enough coin to tie up his loose ends.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Calls strangers 'outlander' and trails off in weary pauses. Talks like an old raider who thinks the Hook is 'ripe as ever for the pickin's'.
